Definition: Position Glean around customer outcomes, differentiation, and partner-led value creation.
Requirements: Complete Foundations, Co-Selling Fundamentals, and Demo Excellence; pass the seller knowledge check; deliver a 10-minute value pitch.
Observable capabilities / outcomes: Tell an executive story; connect pain to outcome; handle objections; run co-sell motions; articulate value.
Accreditation / evidence: Seller / Seller Advanced; role play; ROI case

Definition: Identify, prioritize, and shape high-value multi-team use cases before solution design or implementation.
Requirements: Complete Use Case Discovery Foundations and Outcome Mapping; submit a prioritized use-case worksheet; pass a discovery review.
Observable capabilities / outcomes: Map personas and pain; score opportunities; prioritize use cases; connect workflows to business outcomes.
Learning path(s): Solutions & Value; Sales & GTM; Services & Delivery
Accreditation / evidence: Technical Advisor; case study; discovery workshop

Definition: Design a deployable Glean environment with the required networking, connectivity, configuration, and validation controls.
Requirements: Complete Technical Deep Dive and networking content; pass a configuration workshop; submit an environment and network checklist.
Observable capabilities / outcomes: Assess topology; define allowlisting and connectivity; plan environments; validate connector prerequisites; troubleshoot data paths.
Accreditation / evidence: Solution Architect; design review; deployment checklist

Definition: Apply a governed integration layer for enterprise AI access, orchestration, and reusable platform connectivity.
Requirements: Complete the 201 technical and building foundations; submit a governed gateway/integration architecture; defend security and operating decisions in a capstone review.
Observable capabilities / outcomes: Explain gateway patterns; connect services and tools; enforce access and governance boundaries; define operational ownership.

Definition: Run a structured partner-led delivery motion that aligns teams, milestones, adoption, and realized outcomes.
Requirements: Complete delivery foundations and methodology; submit a kickoff, RAID, and delivery plan; pass a delivery scenario review.
Observable capabilities / outcomes: Lead kickoff; manage delivery stages and RAID; facilitate workshops; measure outcomes; coordinate adoption and handoff.
Accreditation / evidence: Delivery Lead; delivery plan; implementation review

Definition: Stand up, configure, secure, and scale Glean with clear ownership, governance, operating cadence, and Center of Excellence practices.
Requirements: Complete technical deep dive, deployment, and governance content; submit a rollout and CoE governance plan; pass a design review.
Observable capabilities / outcomes: Define roles and guardrails; plan rollout; connect systems; establish governance; run release and risk reviews.
Primary audiences: Architects; delivery leads; practice leads; admins
Learning path(s): Technical & Architecture; Services & Delivery; Operations & Support
Accreditation / evidence: Delivery Lead; Solution Architect; governance plan

Definition: Build reliable partner solutions using agents, actions, MCP, prompts, and reusable orchestration patterns.
Requirements: Complete Building with Glean and Actions & MCP; build an agent with at least two tools and documented test cases; pass the builder lab.
Observable capabilities / outcomes: Choose the right primitive; compose tools and steps; manage memory; implement actions; debug workflows; iterate safely.

Definition: Design, build, test, and hand off custom connectors that meet source, API, authentication, and support requirements.
Requirements: Complete connector prerequisites and best-practices content; build and test a connector in a lab; pass an implementation review.
Observable capabilities / outcomes: Gather requirements; select auth and schema patterns; implement APIs; test rate limits and failure modes; document handoff.

Definition: Extend Glean into partner or customer applications through APIs, SDKs, actions, and embedded user experiences.
Requirements: Complete integration-pattern content; produce a Client API or Web SDK design and working demo; pass an integration review.
Observable capabilities / outcomes: Select integration pattern; use Client API and Web SDK; design embedded workflows; manage authentication and UX boundaries.

Definition: Operate and optimize Glean after launch through recurring support, administration, monitoring, and improvement services.
Requirements: Complete operations runbooks and support-model content; produce a tiered support and escalation runbook; pass a scenario lab.
Observable capabilities / outcomes: Define support tiers; run day-2 operations; manage optimization cadence; own escalations; communicate release readiness.
Primary audiences: Managed services teams; admins; support leads
Accreditation / evidence: Support & Adoption; support model; scenario lab
